scenarios.title: Word timing save
expectedOutcomes: Save a reviewed complete word-timing draft once. Assert exact authored second-word timings, exact optional adjacent first word, unchanged third word, entry text, cues, audio and owned duration. Reopen and Cancel preserves saved state.

scenarios.title: Pending save journal
expectedOutcomes: Save one character edit while a verified host history-directory write refusal prevents package persistence. Assert the exact accepted model and revision, unchanged complete package bytes and exactly one schema-2 pending record with exact label, after-project and local scope.

scenarios.title: Cue draft retention
expectedOutcomes: Enter the exact oversized Unicode direction through the native editor. Assert one scoped draft retains exact text and source prompt, complete loaded/saved canonical projects remain unchanged, and exact journal bytes survive two owned cold reopens.

scenarios.title: Cue draft application
expectedOutcomes: Correct retained direction to valid exact Unicode text. Assert one prompt-only revision, unchanged complete unrelated project data, matching displayed and loaded prompt, and no stale refusal. The expected modification date is the observed finite nondecreasing value.

scenarios.title: Cue draft clear
expectedOutcomes: After observing the exact corrected saved project and UI, observe an empty recovery journal. A third owned reopen preserves complete loaded and saved state and keeps the journal empty.

scenarios.title: Script canonical edit
expectedOutcomes: Replace decomposed text with composed text using the preserved UTF-16 selection. Assert exact saved and displayed text and unchanged word IDs, endpoints and timing ownership.
